name: WhisperX HTTP
description: OpenAI Whisper-based audio transcription service with speaker diarization (pyannote.audio) and word-level timestamps, exposed via FastAPI/uvicorn HTTP wrapper with OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint. No built-in authentication in any major wrapper.
auth_notes: No authentication in any major WhisperX HTTP wrapper by default. Operators are expected to place a reverse proxy (nginx/caddy with basic auth or API key header) in front; most do not. The pyannote.audio diarization backend requires a HuggingFace API token (PYANNOTE_AUTH_TOKEN env var) at container startup — this token is accessible via container environment inspection, process listings, and sometimes via /docs or framework-level env-leak endpoints. Some wrappers (fedirz/faster-whisper-server) accept an optional API_KEY environment variable that gates the Authorization: Bearer header check, but it is unset by default, disabling all auth enforcement.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Direct name match in Swagger UI body or root JSON response; high signal, low volume
Co-occurrence of diarization + transcription on port 8000 is nearly unique to WhisperX-class deployments
OpenAI-compat transcription path rendered in FastAPI Swagger docs body combined with whisper keyword; eliminates non-whisper OpenAI-compat servers
word_segments and speaker are WhisperX-specific response fields that appear in /docs schema examples; very high precision
Version string disclosure in Swagger UI info block or /info endpoint; use for version-targeted enumeration

known_vulns: No built-in auth — unauthenticated POST /v1/audio/transcriptions accepts arbitrary audio files from any source
PYANNOTE_AUTH_TOKEN (HuggingFace token) set in container env; accessible via /proc/1/environ on misconfigured containers or via env-leak framework endpoints
Unrestricted file upload: no MIME-type validation or file size limits in most wrappers — DoS via multi-GB audio files exhausts GPU VRAM and host disk
ffmpeg command injection: wrappers that pass uploaded filename to ffmpeg shell invocation without sanitization allow OS command injection via crafted filenames
FastAPI /docs and /redoc enabled by default — full API schema disclosure aids automated enumeration of all endpoints and parameter shapes
No rate limiting by default — GPU compute exhaustion attack is trivially automated; attacker submits continuous transcription jobs at operator cost
HuggingFace Spaces deployments (common for demos) are publicly indexed with no auth and no usage controls
risk_notes: Primary attack vectors: (1) Compute theft — GPU transcription runs $0.006-0.024/min on cloud GPU rentals; unauth open endpoint = free GPU at operator cost, automatable with any HTTP client. (2) Audio PII exfiltration — medical dictations, legal recordings, financial calls, and corporate meetings processed without consent or audit logging in default configs. (3) HuggingFace token exfiltration — PYANNOTE_AUTH_TOKEN grants access to private HF model repos and bypasses HF rate limits; token value from container env = lateral movement into operator's HF account. (4) Diarization as surveillance — speaker separation from bulk recordings enables identification and tracking of individuals without consent. (5) Voice cloning training data — high-accuracy word-level diarized transcripts are prime training material for TTS and voice cloning models; audio + transcript pairs harvested from open endpoints provide labeled voice datasets.
deployment_notes: Primarily Docker-based on CUDA GPU hosts; CPU-only mode is too slow for production use. Common GPU-as-a-service platforms: Vast.ai, RunPod, Lambda Labs. HuggingFace Spaces deployments are frequent for demos and are publicly indexed. The ahmetoner/whisper-asr-webservice image is the most widely deployed wrapper (port 9000/tcp, endpoints /asr and /detect-language). fedirz/faster-whisper-server targets OpenAI API drop-in replacement use on port 8000/tcp with full /v1/* compatibility. pluja/whishper adds a full web UI on port 8080/tcp with file management. Most enterprise deployments sit behind nginx with basic auth or a VPN, but hobbyist and research deployments frequently expose the raw API port directly to the internet. HuggingFace token required at deploy time for diarization — absent token silently disables speaker labeling without error.
